messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | Mining, Energy, ESG and Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Banjar and JobsKey Search team,

Your Saudi executive-search work across energy, infrastructure, manufacturing and senior leadership, together with your experience sourcing international talent for the Kingdom, makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My current work includes senior engagement with ministries and regulators, cross-functional issue management, renewable-energy transition, carbon-accounting governance, social performance and institutional partnerships. Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across mining, natural resources, energy transition, infrastructure and industrial development. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate, residential and rotational assignments.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming Saudi mandates where a country-facing executive profile with strong institutional and stakeholder depth fits the brief. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
